jobs.description:
Motopp 
 IT Traineeship 12 October 2026 Start your IT-career with Motopp 
Over the course of 27 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The traineeship is fulltime and conducted in English. 
After completing the training, we will start mediation towards a paid job at one of our partner companies across the country. If we find a match, for the next 18 months we will continue to support you with personal coaching sessions, evaluations, and additional workshops. 
Step-by-Step Program - Basic Training (2 weeks): Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. - IT Bootcamp (12 weeks): Consists of three modules: Business IT (Project Management, Business Requirements, Artificial Intelligence), Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI, DevOps), and IT Principles (Testing, ITL, Cloud Computing, Information Security). Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. - Internal Internship (12 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention. Once you're ready to start working, you'll be matched with a position that aligns with your experience and skills, such as a software developer, system administrator, or business analyst. During the first 18 months, you'll get ongoing support with personal coaching, regular feedback, and workshops to help you keep growing ...

We are currently seeking full-time warehouse employees for our new, state-of-the-art distribution center in Oss. This is a long-term position with excellent opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and multicultural environment. Important! This is a physically active role. Lifting crates and materials up to 25 kg is part of the job. Flexibility and a good work ethic are essential! What’s your job about? Inbound: Receive incoming goods from truck drivers. This is not a physically demanding role. CPS (Continuous Packing System): Perform voice picking and operate an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT). While previous experience is preferred, no certifications are required. This role may involve physically demanding tasks depending on the products handled. DPS (Direct Picking System): Similar to pick-to-light systems, products will be delivered to your station. The role requires working efficiently under time pressure but is not physically demanding. The department is located at a higher level in the distribution center, so comfort with heights is essential. Outbound: Organize trolleys and dollies for pick-up. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure products are delivered to the correct locations. This role can be physically demanding, particularly when handling heavier items such as alcohol and cigarettes. Emballage: Manage and recycle empty packaging materials such as bottles, crates, and cans. You will also check trolleys for reuse. This role may involve physically demanding tasks based on the materials handled. You must be flexible, ready to work on each department. What skills do you have? Good command of the English language. Previous experience in logistics and the ability to handle heavier loads (up to 20 kg). Flexibility to work in shifts and willingness to work overtime or weekends when necessary.
